records.statement: A consequential AI configuration shall not be released unless its configuration digest matches the approved authorization and the release is within the approved scope and validity period.
records.verification: Automated deployment policy plus independent release review

records.statement: Every required critical control shall have a passing state and fresh, configuration-matched evidence before a high-consequence release can proceed.
records.verification: Schema validation, traceability validation, policy unit tests, and release-gate evaluation
